notes: DCD (23 Dec 2024) confirms VueNow already had Edge data centers operational in Ghaziabad and Raebareli before the two newly inaugurated sites (Malihabad, Ambedkarnagar); biginfo.in likewise lists Edge Data Centres operational in Ghaziabad and Raebareli. Part of VueNow's 2021 MoU with the UP government (Rs 13,500 crore) to deploy 750 edge data centers by 2028. Size/capacity not disclosed; VueNow is under Enforcement Directorate investigation for the 'cloud particle' scam, so facility substance is unverified at capacity level.
